envelope.description: Build the unit issue module in team mode

body.title: Build the unit issue module in team mode
body.summary: Add src/workflow/tracker/unit-issue.ts: unitLabel, resolveUnitIssueLocal (record then legacy refs with local reconcile), the module-local EnsureResult with phase, ensureUnitIssueDetailed in team mode (local resolve, per-unit label lookup, labels, create with the unit label, link to parent, record at once) with the pre-create and create-phase failure semantics, and ensureUnitIssue as the two-argument PortResult<IssueRef> wrapper. Legacy mode is not built here; tracker-auto keeps its code.
acceptanceChecks: A recorded unit makes no tracker call; a legacy LLD with only storyRef, no units and no unit label creates no second Story issue; a closed issue is adopted.
A failed lookup or label creates nothing and reports phase before-create; a failed create reports phase create and the next call finds the issue by its unit label and creates nothing.
ensureUnitIssue returns PortResult<IssueRef> without a phase and unitLabel gives the three forms, lower-cased, within 50 characters.

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-issue.test.ts: ensureUnitIssue takes a unit and a port and returns a PortResult without a phase
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-issue.test.ts: resolveUnitIssueLocal resolves from records and legacy refs, reconciles locally and runs no command
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-issue.test.ts: a legacy LLD with only storyRef creates no second Story issue
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-issue.test.ts: team mode creates only when everything misses and reports phase before-create or create on failure
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-issue.test.ts: a create that times out after the remote committed is adopted by its label on the next call
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-issue.test.ts: unitLabel gives the three forms, lower-cases ids, stays within 50 characters and rejects a malformed id
